description: Search setlist.fm for venues by name, city, country, or state. Returns a paginated list of matching venues with name, city, and country.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code — "US", not "United States". Call `countries` for the full list.

name.description: Venue name, e.g. "Fillmore". At least one criterion is required.

name: venue_search
